protocol: Exact current allocations and source organization are validated under ordered Time locks held through Billing save.
Approved/Exported/Failed/ReconciliationRequired nonexcluded time lines fence Time financial mutation before bank effects.
Draft, Cancelled and excluded source lines do not freeze unrelated work; cancellation is explicit Finance work.
Source imports preserve committed work and flag review rather than refunding bank hours.
Inbox finalization validates allocation revision, never EntryId alone; only its Time schema is written.
Partial exported Info does not hide excluded Rate: the real supplementary collector retains the remaining 2h.
Lost Billing commit acknowledgement retains one signature and durable financial admission; failed save releases its read lease.
Unprovable historical reads return a typed Finance conflict; no automatic ledger rewriting or new financial table.
